title: Caitlyn Jenner's NSFW Egg Sandwich Comment Makes Kendall Lose Her Appetite on 'The Kardashians'
text:

Sign In SHOP STYLE SNEAKERS MUSIC SPORTS POP CULTURE BETS COVER STORIES VERZUZ WATCH COMPLEXCON Pop Culture Caitlyn Jenner's NSFW Egg Sandwich Comment Makes Kendall Lose Her Appetite on 'The Kardashians'
 A family visit took an unexpected turn when Caitlyn's lunch conversation left her daughter speechless and Scott Disick entertained.
 By Maggie Ekberg October 23, 2026 Comments Comment Save Share Comments Comments Photo by George Pimentel/Getty Images Key Takeaways
 Caitlyn Jenner made a rare appearance on The Kardashians, joining Kendall Jenner as she prepared to welcome her horses to a new property. 
 During lunch with Scott Disick, Caitlyn made a censored NSFW remark about an egg sandwich that horrified Kendall and prompted her to declare, “I can’t eat it anymore!” 
 Despite the awkward exchange and their “completely different views,” Kendall called the visit “great” and said having Caitlyn there for the horses’ arrival mattered to her. 
 Caitlyn Jenner returned to The Kardashians for a little father-daughter bonding, but the conversation wasn't exactly family-friendly.
 On the Oct. 22 episode of the Hulu series, the 76-year-old former Olympian joined Kendall, 30, as she waited for her horses to arrive at her new property. But before the animals arrived, Caitlyn couldn't resist a little parental interrogation.
 “So since I never get to know, how's the love life?” she asked, according to People . Kendall wasn't particularly interested in discussing her dating life on camera. When her father pressed for reassurance that everything was going well, she replied, “I am so okay it's unbelievable.”
 Things only got more uncomfortable when Scott Disick joined them for lunch.
 "That is a very good-looking egg sandwich," Caitlyn said before taking a bite that sent yolk running down her hand. “Oh my God, I took a bite and it like [bleep] in my mouth.” Hulu censored the word, but Kendall's face did not. “Dad, oh my God,” she exclaimed.
 Caitlyn apologized, explaining that the egg had “squirted” everywhere. “I don't think I've ever heard you say that. I could've lived my whole life without hearing you say that,” Kendall responded. Disick, meanwhile, thought the exchange was hilarious. He joked that he used to get in trouble for making similar comments, while Caitlyn announced that she might need a shower after the messy meal.
 Kendall had heard enough and finally gave up on her sandwich. "I can't eat it anymore!" she declared.
 The appearance marks Caitlyn's first time on the Hulu series since October 2025, when her ex-wife Kris Jenner invited her to a farewell dinner at the family's longtime Hidden Hills home. The reunion was also Caitlyn's first appearance on the show since its 2022 debut.
 During that episode, Kendall admitted that she and her father sometimes get frustrated with each other because they have “completely different views,” but emphasized that she still wants Caitlyn included in family gatherings.
 And despite this week's uncomfortable lunch, Kendall ultimately described the visit as “great.” Having her dad there for the arrival of her horses was important to her, even if the sandwich conversation was one she'd rather forget.
